diversity.interpretation: Opportunity and chosen-build counts, not a mandate to force an industry. Pottery Flex identity is held out, never Pottery actions.

economy.interpretation: Counts use public predecision views; build level is the next public mat tile. A legal alternative to Pass need not be good. Sale starts and continuation tile choices are separate. Last-seen unflipped tiles are not exact end-of-era waste; scoring may follow the last view.
